newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rebounds with NYMEX, U.K. demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rebounds with NYMEX, U.K. demand.

text.p: NWE gasoline rebounded on Friday as the market was pulled up by a strong performance on crude and NYMEX unleaded futures, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded early at $215.50 and $216 a tonne fob ARA but recovered later to trade close to Thursday's levels at $218. Regular unleaded barges traded at $203.50 and $204.

On the cargoes, buying interest was seen from U.K. refiners, possibly the start of a tank-filling exercise ahead of the U.K. budget in late November which is expected to raise excise duty by eight percent, or $50/$60 a tonne.
Uncovered shorts for 95 unleaded were seen into Poland.
